collection_info.name: CryptoDickbutts S3
collection_info.description: Once a utopia, Gooch Island has fallen and CryptoDickbutts have been evacuated. Series 3 features 5200 all new CryptoDickbutts, each with a set of randomly generated traits.

collection_info.name: Sad Frogs District
collection_info.description:
6993 Sad Frogs are programmatically generated from a random combination of more than 200 traits. Sad Frogs live on the Ethereum blockchain in form of ERC-721 tokens.

The Frogs are inspired by collective artworks of internet artists and cyberpunk aesthetics.

collection_info.name: Strawberry.wtf
collection_info.description: Strawberry.wtf are 10,000 unique mutant strawberry NFTs that never asked to be born this way. Legend says, every 420 years, the Strawberry Moon rises to summon verifiably unique strawberry abominations on the Ethereum blockchain! That's not all! These strawberries grant access to the Strawberry.wtf Gameboy game! Visit www.strawberry.wtf for more information, roadmap, and membership portal!
